dedupe_keys.name: geer reconnaissance of 2018 palu donggala earthquake and flowslides

description: GEER Reconnaissance of 2018 Palu-Donggala Earthquake and Flowslides is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Jack Montgomery, Auburn University (auburn.edu). The Mw7.5 Palu-Donggala earthquake occurred on 28 September 2018 and caused significant damage in Palu City and the surrounding Central Sulawesi region of Indonesia. The earthquake initiated a series of catastrophic landslides (classified as flowslides), collapsed buildings, and generated tsunami waves that impacted the coast of Palu Bay. Coverage: Palu, Central Sulawesi, Indonesia. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Earthquake reconnaissance, Flowslide, landslide, liquefaction, ground failure, digital surface model. Published 2020-09-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
